them.en: The skill makes the agent do
them.zh: 这个 skill 让 agent 做的

steps.en: Install Scrapling and its browsers, then copy this repo into your skills folder
steps.zh: 装好 Scrapling 和浏览器，再把仓库拷进 skills 目录

steps.en: Ask for the page in plain words
steps.code: This site has Cloudflare, scrape it anyway: https://protected.example.com

steps.en: Checks the Scrapling version, then reads the safety and site-pattern notes
steps.zh: 先查 Scrapling 版本，再读安全说明和站点笔记

steps.en: Tries the one-line CLI first, with page text cleaned for the model
steps.zh: 先试一行 CLI，网页文本清洗后再给模型

steps.en: For anything harder, picks a fetcher from the decision tree and fills in a template
steps.zh: 更难的情况按决策树选 Fetcher，填好模板脚本

steps.en: Runs it, returns the fields you asked for, and notes the site pattern for next time
steps.zh: 执行并返回你要的字段，顺手记下站点模式

value.en: You stop telling the agent which fetcher, cookie shape and timeout unit each kind of site needs
value.zh: 不用再告诉 agent 每类站点该用哪个 Fetcher、cookie 什么格式、超时什么单位
